method: Opened and parsed all three SVGs; rendered their actual vector elements offline with Pillow for visual inspection. Browser file URL was blocked; no browser workaround was used.
notes: TOP is uncluttered because every jumper is on the underside.
BOTTOM is mirrored, with TOP hole identities retained.
Original tool renderings are *.tool.svg; annotations add true nominal outline/M3/USB without changing placement or wiring.
Nominal origin and M3 geometry require real-board dry fit; proposed outline is not a construction release.
